description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasController's snapshot parameters parsing logic, verifying default values, parsing of various formats, and handling of quality clamp.

classes.name: CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest
classes.description: Test class for CanvasController snapshot parameters parsing logic.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsDefaultsToJpeg
methods.description: Tests that default snapshot parameters are set to JPEG format when null input is provided.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesPng
methods.description: Verifies that parsing a JSON with format 'png' correctly sets the format and maxWidth.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesJpegAliases
methods.description: Checks that 'jpeg' and 'jpg' formats are correctly interpreted as JPEG.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsClampsQuality
methods.description: Ensures that the quality parameter is properly clamped or adjusted within expected bounds.
